title: Prove uniform exceptional-record repair across complex recursion
body:
PR2250 gives a per-call exceptional-record repair tariff, while PR2287 uses it inside a weighted recursive complex layer. This audit proves one constant for the total repair tariff over every descendant, provided each call preserves the complete long coefficient record and compact guard ranges.

The bound is `(1000000000/5333) J V d^(99733167/100000000)`, where J bounds repair calls per node. The exact selected histogram and strict moment certify the geometric factor; Gamma cancels through the actual volume rule. Two executable countermodels preserve volume or identity endpoints while exposing the cost failures from splitting coefficient records or reusing a global bad density on a bad-only compact fibre.

This is a conditional repair-only composition theorem, not a source bug, new dimension point, full supplier invoice or kappa improvement. Ordinary interchanges, other control preparation, scalar/leaf work, parking, endpoint realization, precision and analytic transfer remain separate. No selected inputs change.

Validation: registered CPython 3.12 replay, optimized 3.14 direct checks and Git-free export pass. Evidence includes 288 tariff fixtures, 10,880 symbolic row edges, exact weighted recurrences, rational and separately implemented outward integer moment intervals, executed cost countermodels and 4 independent controls. Both engines reject source corruption; receipt regeneration rejects an altered receipt without overwriting it. A separate AI reviewer inspected the proof/code and replayed both optimized 3.12 commands; no blocking issue found.

```sh
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/complex-record-amortization
```

Canonical main: `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2`, priority revision 4. Task `uniform-transfer-audit`, nonce `ceb6f4241485d166b687ebed6e76d0b8`. Final live overlap at 2026-10-15T11:59:16Z covers 673 open PRs and 1,192 discussion records, complete pagination and no warnings; source heads 2250/2287/2365 rechecked unchanged. Arbitrary diffs and unpublished work are outside search coverage.
